question: The Prayag Sangeet Samiti at Prayagraj was established in the year _________ to teach Hindustani classical music.
solution:
The correct answer is** 1926.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prayag Sangeet Samiti**

 
 
• It was established on the auspicious day of Maha Shivaratri by Ranjit Singh, Late Baijnath Sahai and Late Satyanand Joshi.
 
• The Samiti is an organization registered under the Indian Societies Act of 1860.</li&g
